description: Source code for stream flash memory operations in Zephyr OS, including flash page erasure, buffered writing, progress saving/loading, and initialization.

methods.name: settings_direct_loader
methods.description: Loads progress data from settings storage into stream_flash_ctx.

methods.name: stream_flash_erase_page
methods.description: Erases a flash page at a specified offset if within range.

methods.name: flash_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes buffered data to flash memory, handling erasure and write.

methods.name: stream_flash_buffered_write
methods.description: Writes data to flash with buffering, optionally flushing.

methods.name: stream_flash_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to flash.

methods.name: stream_flash_init
methods.description: Initializes the stream flash context with device, buffer, and parameters.

methods.name: stream_flash_progress_load
methods.description: Loads progress state from settings storage.

methods.name: stream_flash_progress_save
methods.description: Saves progress state to settings storage.

methods.name: stream_flash_progress_clear
methods.description: Clears progress state from settings storage.
